title: MapDev

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
You can get moderator by applying in the staff applications section. However, mod applications are closed.

Map developers are hand-picked people, chosen by staff and other developers. They help create, develop, and critique maps. You can become a map developer by helping out the community in creating maps, coding YML files, giving feedback, etc.

Good luck!
